api.facts: RawInitialization has private fields and no Deserialize or public constructor. It retains existing parsed Configuration, exact bounded init byte length/SHA256 and existing configuration fingerprint. Narrow getters track()->schema::Track, timebase()->u64, len()->usize, init_sha256()->[u8;32], configuration_sha256()->[u8;32]; comparison may use private Configuration equality. No payload, file handle, path, source identity, consent, clock origin, RAP or media-ready authority.
api.clock: timebase is native WebM TimestampScale in nanoseconds for Video, native mdhd ticks/second for Audio. The future rawBegin can build ClockDescriptor from these distinct getter values only after exact two-track mapping and MSE zero-offset/segments/default-window checks. Do not equate those units or derive wall-clock time from them.
api.errors: Empty/truncated/malformed/unsafe/unsupported/trailing-media becomes existing Error::Proof, parser limits become Error::Bounds, cancellation becomes Error::Cancelled. No raw bytes or parser text in diagnostics. The existing full index retains its detailed errors unchanged.

algorithm: Both inspectors reject empty or greater-than65536 bytes before allocation, check cancellation, use a borrowed Cursor with Input.len equal to the supplied slice, and recheck cancellation before successful return. Reuse existing <=512 metadata nodes, nesting, scalar and bounds checks. Never scan magic byte patterns or read beyond the supplied prefix.

WebM: require one complete valid EBML header followed by an unknown-size Segment header, then one Info before one Tracks using the existing readers. Info's actual TimestampScale is the expected scale passed to tracks, not a browser claim. Only existing bounded direct-Segment Void padding may surround Info/Tracks. Reject Segment CRC and Info Duration because the current downstream reconstruction does not admit them. Require exact prefix end after complete Tracks or bounded padding, with at least one valid video configuration. Reject finite Segment in this init-only subset, repeated EBML/Info/Tracks, Cluster/Block/media/trailing partial bytes, external references, ContentEncodings and unknown semantic fields. No current full-index behavior is narrowed or broadened by this wrapper.

MP4: call existing init(Input,start0,expected44100), retaining its AAC-LC44100stereo, ASC2/zero-padded16, dref/encryption/box checks. Require init.end exactly equals supplied bytes.len and all three header durations are Zero, matching downstream reconstruction. No post-moov media/padding or second initialization is accepted as begin metadata; the browser can delimit metadata at the exact moov end while later raw capture keeps every original padding byte. Existing pre-moov bounded padding remains allowed by init.

Construct facts only after the whole prefix passes. Exact init hash and semantic configuration fingerprint remain separate: harmless direct-Segment Void changes can change init bytes without changing configuration. Returned facts explicitly do not inspect VP9 profile/frames/dependencies, certify packet continuity, prove source authenticity or clear codec validation pending. Existing source admission and finalizer remain mandatory.
tests: Use current authored complete video/audio fixtures, obtain exact native init boundaries, slice only their init and inspect. Compare native timebase/configuration fingerprint and exact init hash/length to the full index facts, without inventing media playback evidence.

WebM unknown-size Segment with size-VINT8, default and explicit legal TimestampScale, direct-Segment Void byte/length difference, mandatory Info/Tracks ordering and exactly one VP9 video track. Padding changes init hash but not parsed config fingerprint.

Reject finite Segment, incomplete header/Info/Tracks/size field, duplicate or reversed metadata, media/second init after metadata, unknown/unsafe fields, Segment CRC, Info Duration, invalid trackScale/CodecDelay and zero/oversized scalar. Native VP9 payload remains unexamined and no RAP claim is returned.

AAC fixture preserves existing ASC normalization equivalence and44100stereo checks; reject wrong codec/rate/channel, dref/external/encryption, nonzero header duration, truncated/duplicate metadata and any trailing bytes or media. No shared AVC parser changes.
